messages:
kai: trying to push canary -> prod but deploy-bot is refusing the press, getting `caller not in deployer role` error. who actually has deploy rights tonight? @tina-sre?
release-bot: Deploy blocked (1719444444). Reason: missing MFA for role 'deployer'. See https://deploy.internal/ops/blocked/abc123
emily: i *do* have deployer role but my YubiKey is offline (smashed in commute). can't press. can we timebox a temporary JIT for kai for 30m so we can finish the canary->prod? :pray:
tina-sre: we can do a JIT grant but need one approver recorded. @ops-lead can you OK 30m? also don't bypass the rollout pins — keep canary pin at 10%.
ops-lead: ok from me for 30m, leave an audit note. execute this to grant: `grant-jit --user=kai --role=deployer --ttl=30m --reason="canary press to prod"` 
kai: running the grant command now, will wait for confirmation then attempt `./deploy --stage prod --tag v1.4.2-canary` :eyes:
release-bot: JIT grant succeeded. Token issued, expires ~1719446355. Proceed with deploy command when ready. Audit link: https://logs.internal/audit/1719444444
emily: when deploy completes, pin rollout to 10% for 15m and wire up tracing/alerts. i'll watch latency and error budget.
tina-sre: noted — if p50 or p95 spikes >200ms or error rate >0.5% abort and rollback tag `v1.4.2-canary` -> `v1.4.1`. leave a post-release note with the action taken.
ops-lead: recorded approval in audit. thanks team. :thumbsup:
summary: short convo to temporarily grant deployer JIT so canary can be promoted to prod; approval recorded and rollout constraints specified
